You'll join the Engineering & Technology Program Management team, a group that treats planning and tracking as real engineering work, not administrative overhead. Along the way, you'll be taught to see cost and schedule as engineering variables in their own right, a lens that's genuinely valuable whether you're headed toward program leadership or engineering management down the road.
